body_markdown:
At our **2026 Investor Day** at the New York Stock Exchange last Tuesday, IonQ demonstrated how it is accelerating into the fault-tolerant era as a fully integrated, full-stack quantum leader. Spanning **computing, sensing, networking, and quantum-safe security** , our platform is now backed by dedicated quantum design and mass-manufacturing capabilities. And across proclamation after proclamation by our leaders throughout the day - with topics ranging from technology, to operations, to financial results – IonQ continues to validate its grand vision and plan.


**Executive Vision: Leading the Full-Stack Quantum Era**


Opening the event at the NYSE, IonQ CEO **Niccolo de Masi** highlighted how vertical integration is accelerating product cycles, expanding enterprise adoption, and protecting critical global infrastructure.


> *“I'm excited about the fact that we are not only the largest quantum company in history, but we're the first one that is vertically integrated.”*
> — **Niccolo de Masi, IonQ CEO**


He described how the four main pillars of this vertical integration–quantum computing, quantum sensing, quantum networking, and quantum-safe security–are now joined by quantum foundry capabilities from SkyWater Technology, the acquisition of which IonQ officially closed on July 31. Integrating SkyWater’s design and mass-manufacturing capabilities into IonQ’s existing platforms will drive the company's next phase of rapid innovation by allowing it to leverage faster learning cycles. It also will help provide reliable supply chain support for the broader, emerging US quantum sector.


> *“Not only are we investing in driving merchant supply to accelerate the U.S. industry and our allies, but we're also speeding up our own roadmap because of this vertical integration.”*
> — **Niccolo de Masi, IonQ CEO**


That roadmap acceleration is most evident in IonQ’s Investor Day launch of its next quantum computing hardware line–Superion–but de Masi also said IonQ continues to set the industry pace with development of new applications in fields like computation engineering, logistics, predictive medicine, pharmaceuticals, advanced satellite image analysis, and more.


> “We believe we're just scratching the tip of the iceberg here. There will be far more applications than we can think of in advance as our machines roll out, and far more exciting applications we hope will be created by people building businesses and doing research with our machines at arm's length.”
> — **Niccolo de Masi, IonQ CEO**


The acceleration also extends to quantum security, where de Masi said that IonQ continues to be a responsible steward of both the quantum computing capabilities that can challenge current encryption and the multi-layer security innovation that can defend the world from those threats.


What all of this adds up to is a company and vertically integrated platform strategy that is delivering on investor expectations.


> *“To have revenue, you've got to have a technical milestone that's hit, a product that works, a customer that buys it, and of course, machines that are delivered that do useful things. We've been doing that longer than anyone in our sector. We continue to do it, and of course, we're doing it at an accelerating rate.”*
> — **Niccolo de Masi, IonQ CEO**


## **Unveiling Superion 256: The Next Era of Hardware Scale**


IonQ officially opened orders for **Superion 256** , the flagship system of our sixth-generation quantum computing line built to scale directly to millions of qubits. Initial customer deliveries are scheduled for 2027.


‍


> *“If we want to build out systems with orders of magnitude more qubits and deploy orders of magnitude more of them, which we definitely do, we need to radically simplify the platform. At the same time, we need to learn faster. We need to go from learning over product cycles of years to product cycles of months, and thirdly, we need to demonstrate scale. We need to build platforms which generation after generation build on each other to allow us to tackle problems that can't be tackled any other way.”*
> — **Dr. Chris Ballance, IonQ President of Quantum Computing**


## **Key Architectural Breakthroughs**


- **Electronic Qubit Control (EQC):** Replaces complex optical laser setups with chip-integrated classical electronics. Originating from our Oxford Ionics acquisition, EQC reduces cost-per-qubit by over **300x** across our roadmap while improving system stability.


> *"\[EQC\] allows us to take out this whole middle layer of laser control, directly connecting our classical control electronics to our quantum chip, and build out these quantum chips in standard semiconductor ways."*
> — **Dr. Chris Ballance, IonQ President of Quantum Computing**


- **Quantum Multiplexed I/O & Walking Cat Architecture:** Enables single unit cells to control dense qubit arrays while unifying error-correction codes into a single, simplified compute fabric across the entire stack.


## **Own the Foundry, Control the Future: The SkyWater Advantage**


Bringing SkyWater Technologies into the IonQ family transforms our speed of innovation and manufacturing scale:


- **Rapid Hardware Iteration:** Reduced our 256-qubit product development cycle from **9 months down to just 2 months** .
- **Unmatched Production Capacity:** Delivered **12x more wafer lots** over a six-month period compared to previous third-party suppliers.
- **Mass Manufacturing:** Thousands of quantum wafers are actively running through the fab today, with a third dedicated directly to IonQ hardware.


> *"Today, we have thousands, literally thousands, of quantum wafers running in our fab. A third of those are tied to IonQ. What that means is we're designing for manufacturability. When it's time to run at scale, we will be ready."*
> — **Thomas Sonderman, CEO of SkyWater Technologies**


SkyWater continues to serve as an open commercial foundry for the broader quantum ecosystem, highlighted by a new multi-year partnership with **Qolab** to advance superconducting device production.


## **Redefining Cybersecurity: Safecracking and Safemaking**


IonQ published the world’s first compiled end-to-end blueprint demonstrating how Shor’s Algorithm on a **19,397-physical-qubit trapped-ion system** could break 256-bit Elliptic-Curve signatures (secp256k1) - the core cryptography safeguarding Bitcoin and blockchain networks - in under 26 days.


> *"We offer customers quantum security posture management, or QSPM, which gives them visibility into their full infrastructure to determine where they are vulnerable to potential quantum attacks. Then we offer a CNSA 2.0 and NIST compliant solution that allows you to continue to update your infrastructure to be quantum secure, whether that be using PQC, or post-quantum cryptography, and injecting that throughout your infrastructure, or doing quantum key distribution, a physical solution that can span your entire network.”*
> — **Jordan Shapiro, IonQ President and GM of Quantum Platform**


To counter this compressed threat timeline, IonQ delivers complete, end-to-end quantum security solutions:


- **Quantum Security Posture Management (QSPM):** Provides complete network visibility to pinpoint infrastructure vulnerabilities prior to Q-Day.
- **PQC & QKD Deployments:** Combines NIST/CNSA 2.0-compliant Post-Quantum Cryptography with physical Quantum Key Distribution to safeguard critical enterprise data.
- **National Rollout:** Announced an **$8.18 million agreement with Congruity360** to deploy a quantum-safe network protecting enterprise data across the U.S.


Addressing IonQ’s unique position in both pioneering next-generation computing and building defenses against emerging quantum threats, de Masi summarized our strategic role:


> *"You want a safecracker to be the one who builds your safe."*
> — **Niccolo de Masi, IonQ CEO**


## **Financial Momentum: Raising 2026 Outlook to $450M–$460M**


Following the closing of the SkyWater acquisition, IonQ elevated its full-year 2026 revenue guidance to **$450 million–$460 million** (up from $280M–$290M), representing a **>60% step-up** .


> *"We are the pacesetter, but the industry is moving. We're happy they're moving. We need the industry to emerge – one company does not an industry make, so we want others to also succeed in their endeavors."*
> — **Inder M. Singh, IonQ COO/CFO**


## **The One-Stop Shop for the Quantum Economy**


IonQ has completed its transformation from a single-purpose quantum computer builder into a unified, full-stack enterprise spanning **computing, sensing, networking, security, and manufacturing** .


> *"The point is, end-to-end quantum everything. Think of this company as the one-stop shop for quantum, not just computing... We have a strategy to land and expand. It doesn't matter where the discussion starts – it's a question of how many of our products they will use."*
> — **Inder M. Singh, IonQ COO/CFO**
